# Understand the program behind the screen
Your AI can build a working app quickly. Understanding its permissions, state changes and hidden dep
endencies takes a clearer view.
**VibeLens connects the model you confirm, the code your agent writes, and what actually happens whe
n you run it.** Follow one operation from business intent to the value, function or query that expla
ollow one operation from business intent to the value, function or query that explains its behavior.
## Confirm the model before the code
> “Use $vibelens for this project. Show me the business flow, states and rules so we can confirm how
for this project. Show me the business flow, states and rules so we can confirm how it should work.”
VibeLens turns the conversation into connected **business, state and rule graphs**. Clarify the impo
rtant details, see the graph, then build. Choose **Drive** to develop from executable state declarat
ions, or **Observe** to inspect your application's own logic.
## Follow the evidence to the source
Record an operation and replay its state and value changes. Keep the relevant chain in a custom view
, expand a decision and its inputs, then open the highlighted source.
Tell your coding agent what you found. VibeLens keeps the model, source mappings and checks alongsid
e the change. Run it again and inspect the result.
**Try the interactive walkthrough →**
## One graph, the detail you need
| Start with a question | Follow it through the graph |

| What should happen? | Business actions, object states and shared rules |
| Where is it implemented

? | Entry points → folders and files → functions and parameters |
| What changed at runtime? | Captu

red inputs, decisions, states, queries and effects |
| What matters in this iteration? | A saved cus
tom view, focused recording and synchronized timeline |
Switch between **2D and 3D**, expand a region, filter relationships, and keep your layout and annota
tions as the code evolves. Live observation, recording and replay share the same graph.
